DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

The brief duration of three minutes, the onset while rolling over in bed, and the absence of hearing loss or neurological deficits are classic for BPPV. No further imaging or audiology is needed as the diagnosis is clinical. We will proceed with the Dix-Hallpike maneuver and a trial of canalith repositioning therapy (Epley maneuver).
